process.title: A clear process to arrive calm on the big day.
process.text: We guide you step by step to turn ideas, references and needs into an executable proposal you can quote with confidence.

steps.title: We listen to your vision
steps.description: You share the date, celebration type, the style that inspires you, priorities and approximate budget.

steps.title: We visit and measure the venue
steps.description: When needed, we review dimensions, access, heights, installation points, lighting and layouts.

steps.title: We build a creative route
steps.description: We propose colors, flowers, textures and layouts that feel coherent between ceremony, reception and details.

steps.title: We solve questions and refine
steps.description: We keep direct contact to clarify questions, refine ideas and adjust the proposal if priorities change.

steps.title: We produce, install and close with you
steps.description: We take care of preparation, transport and installation so you get clarity, calm and smooth execution.

form.title: Every great celebration starts with a conversation.
form.text: Before talking about flowers, we want to know your story, understand what you imagine and discover what will make your celebration special. From there, we will design a proposal made exclusively for you.

steps.copy: Every great event starts with an idea. Tell us a bit about the celebration you are imagining.
This information helps us understand the size and location of your celebration.

steps.legend: Do you already have a venue?
steps.copy: If you already have a venue, it helps us review logistics and available spaces.
We want to know the spaces you want to decorate so we can start imagining a proposal tailored to you.
Now let's talk about the atmosphere you imagine and how much guidance you need to define it.
If you already have a palette in mind, we will note it here. If not, we can propose one with you.
Tell us how you imagine your event, what atmosphere you want to create or any detail you think is important.
With this information we can prepare a proposal much closer to what you are looking for.
If there is anything else we should know, tell us here.
We are almost done. We just need your details to send your personalized proposal.
